description: This file defines the HtmlSanitizer class which provides functionality for sanitizing HTML content to prevent XSS vulnerabilities, using HTMLPurifier, and includes configuration setup, caching, and helper methods for cleaning HTML and removing tags.

classes.name: HtmlSanitizer
classes.description: A class for sanitizing HTML content by removing potentially dangerous code and ensuring safe HTML output using the HTMLPurifier library. Implements singleton pattern for instance management and provides static methods for cleaning HTML strings.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the HtmlSanitizer class, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: cleanHtml
methods.description: Sanitizes the provided HTML string to prevent XSS and other injection issues; optionally removes HTML tags.

methods.name: stripTags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from the input string, decoding if necessary, and encodes back if original input was encoded.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Performs the core HTML sanitization, decoding entities, applying regex for email conversion, and using HTMLPurifier to remove or encode HTML based on parameters.

methods.name: applyConfigs
methods.description: Merges base and extra configuration options and applies them to the HTMLPurifier configuration object.
